title: Airbus Overtook Boeing After The 737 MAX Crisis
source: Boeing and Airbus annual commercial aircraft delivery totals, from company delivery reports and SEC filings (Boeing Form 8-K delivery releases; Airbus orders-and-deliveries data), as compiled by Reuters, CNBC, AirlineGeeks and Simple Flying. Boeing: 748 (2016), 763 (2017), 806 (2018), 380 (2019), 157 (2020), 340 (2021), 480 (2022), 528 (2023). Airbus: 688 (2016), 718 (2017), 800 (2018), 863 (2019), 566 (2020), 611 (2021), 661 (2022), 735 (2023). Boeing's 2019-2020 collapse followed the 737 MAX grounding and the COVID-19 pandemic; Airbus became the world's top-selling planemaker starting in 2019.
